trajectory.units: metres (SI), unwrapped: a tracer that crossed the periodic boundary keeps going, so displacements are physical and no image flag is needed
trajectory.ordering: frame i is particles.position of GSD frame i, shape (1, 3), row = tracer index, fixed across frames
trajectory.index_0: the initial configuration at simulated time 0, before any step
trajectory.step_counter: configuration.step is the integer step count at that frame; simulated time is step * integration_timestep (derived, never accumulated)
trajectory.box: configuration.box = [0.0005]*3 + [0,0,0], in metres, the same unit as the positions
